metadata.case_name: NG HIU MAN v. TRADE IN ASIA LTD

injuries.description: contusion and possible strain of the muscles of her lower back
source: the injury to her back is likely to be some kind of contusion and possible strain of the muscles of her lower back.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

injuries.description: multiple levels disc degeneration with bulging of intervertebral discs at L2-S1 levels, mild bilateral nerve root compression at L2/L3, mild left nerve root compression at L3/L4, mild right nerve root compression at L4/L5 and a small annular tear at L3/L4
source: the MRI report revealed bulging of intervertebral discs at L2-S1 levels with mild bilateral nerve root compression at L2/L3, mild left nerve root compression at L3/L4, and mild right nerve root compression at L4/L5.
the latest MRI of the plaintiffs lumbar spine showed multiple levels disc degeneration without significant nerve root compression and it also showed a small annular tear at L3/L4 level.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

manifestations.description: Left side stretching back pain and stiffness; intermittent attack especially on prolonged sitting or standing for more than one hour, or lifting heavy object. Such pain and stiffness occasionally occurred at night time once in every 3 to 4 days and required intake of analgesic.

Left lower limb numbness over anterior thigh, buttock and leg with intermittent attack around once every 2 to 3 days and with each attack lasted for a few minutes. Such symptoms would be aggravated by prolonged sitting for more than one hour, or prolonged standing for over 45 minutes to one hour.

Activities of daily living and the use of public transportation were manageable but with some inconvenience as the plaintiff claimed that she would need to use a stick for doing long journeys or journeys with prolonged walking for more than 30 minutes.

treatments_received: Accident and Emergency Department of the Prince of Wales Hospital consultation and treatment
private medical consultations (Town Health Medical Centre; Ever Health Medical Center)
consultation at Hong Kong Traumatology and Orthopaedics Institute

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities (PSLA) award. "In my assessment, an award of HK$120,000.00 with one-third reduction for the plaintiffs chronic pre-existing degeneration of her lumbar spine is appropriate. Hence, the discounted sum is therefore HK$80,000.00."
Loss of earning capacity award of HK$50,000.00 as agreed by the defendant for loss of earning capacity.
